description: Return the free overview excerpt for a flagship engineering guide plus the apex take-away link and cited source books (EP-204). Optionally supply a section name to get a specific section summary and its grounding citations.

section.description: Section name substring, e.g. 'decoupling'. Returns the first matching section's summary and grounding citations.

slug.description: Guide slug: software-engineering, ai-engineering, or data-engineering.

name: get_guide_section
title: Get a guide's free overview and cited sources
